questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

7 × 96 ÷ 8 + 39 - 25 = 70
questions.solution:
The given equation: 7 × 96 ÷ 8 + 39 - 25 = 70

1) × and ÷ 

On interchanging × and ÷, we get:

7 ÷ 96 × 8 + 39 - 25 

⇒ 7 ÷ 12 + 14 ≠ 70 (incorrect)

2) + and -

On interchanging + and -, we get:

7

questions.question:
Which number will replace the question mark (?) in the following series?

11, 17, 28, 51, 96, 187, 368, ?
IF VERSION is coded as 1712121621225 and TEARFUL is coded as 15189154223, then how will LOCALITY be coded?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/62e26ed77000b461752d79eb0e8ea2a5a50c72a4083d9909e1687361b18b5713.png] 

The pattern being followed here is:

**Letters are arranged in reverse order.**

**And then letters are increased or decreased by +3, or -3 alternatively.**

VERSION is coded as 1712121621225

 
• **VERSION → Reverse order → NOISREV**
 
• **Letters are increased or decreased by +3, or -3 alternatively.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/453266dcd283d3b8640045d41f09808e611c7d680fbbb3107fbf234b4d933499.png] 

TEARFUL is coded as 15189154223

 
• TEARFUL → Reverse order → LUFRAET
 
• Letters are increased or decreased by +3, or -3 alternatively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea8768ea3d05d3440093b0f80e46dd38456a932340ac1ed66e7d863bc3607a6a.png] 

Similarly,

**LOCALITY be coded ?**

 
• **LOCALITY → Reverse order → YTILACOL.**
 
• **Letters are increased or decreased by +3, or -3 alternatively.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc393b9cfadfe6c295144ae8fff2c34bf896ea2fcb12bfad3faab22d4ad798b2.png] 

Hence, **281712940189** is the code for LOYALTY.

questions.question: Aravind and Biswanath start at the same time from their hostel and go to the ground with speeds of 30 km/h and 60 km/h, respectively. If Aravind takes 20 minutes longer than Biswanath to reach the ground, then find the distance between their hostel and the ground.
questions.solution:
The speed of Aravind = 30 kmph

The speed of Biswanath = 60 kmph

Let the time take by Biswanath = X hours

Implies, the time taken by Aravind = X hours + 20 minutes = (X + 1/3) hours

Now,

Speed × Time = Distance

30 × (X + 1/3) = 60 × X 

⇒ 30X + 10 = 60X

⇒ 30X = 10

⇒ X = 1/3 hours = 20 minutes

Distance = 1/3 × 60 = 20 km

Hence, the distance between the hostel and the ground is **20 km**.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(11, 19, 59)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**(1st number + 2nd number) × 2 - 1 = 3rd number**

(11, 19, 59)

(11 + 19) × 2 - 1

= 30 × 2 - 1

= 60 - 1 = 59

**Option 3: (8, 13, 41)**

**(8 + 13) × 2 - 1**

**= 21 × 2 - 1 **

**= 42 - 1 = 41**

Hence, the correct answer is **"(8, 13, 41)".**
